summary: Slot 4 (the tree only: no PPO, no rollouts; the network learns only from MCTS trees rooted on its own greedy line). Three recipes from scratch on one box (the box was mostly idle under one): v1 = run 5's tree as is (3-min searches, roots on the last 20 s): 16 rounds, 1.05B ticks, eval best 1.92%, stuck on the spawn platform - the trees find the landings (1.8-2.8%) and the network learns them at the line's states (100% on its own line rows) but its greedy cannot reproduce them; v2 = roots over the whole greedy line + advantage-weighted node labels: best 2.19% at 0.28B; v3 = v2 + the yaw sigma fitted to the tree's targets (run 5's random children narrowed as PPO narrowed sigma; here nothing did). First ramp (8%) deadline 2.0B total ticks: v1 at ~23:15 UTC, v2 later, v3 later still. Run 5 cleared it at 0.76B total.
